previewText: Gwinnett County market snapshot for August 2026, Test Every Smoke Alarm Before Heating Season and Gwinnett Hispanic Latino Heritage Month Celebration, and a short note from Danny.

paragraphs: Fall officially arrives this week, and even if the weather has not fully gotten the message yet, it is a good time to handle one small safety check around the house.
This week I included a quick smoke-alarm reminder, an upcoming Gwinnett celebration, and the latest Gwinnett County market numbers. I hope you find something useful to pass along.

market.title: Gwinnett County market snapshot for August 2026
market.source: Realtor.com Economic Research county inventory data
paragraphs: For the Wednesday, September 23, 2026 update, Realtor.com shows 3,828 active listings in Gwinnett County for August 2026, 11.4% higher from one year earlier. The median listing price was $450,000, with a median market time of 54 days, 5.9% higher year over year.

The practical takeaway for this Wednesday, September 23, 2026 issue is to judge a home against its closest current competition. Countywide figures provide context, but condition, pricing, and the activity in a specific neighborhood still shape the result.
market.verificationNote: Source: Realtor.com Economic Research county inventory data for August 2026. Verified counties available to this run: Gwinnett County, Barrow County, Walton County, Rockdale County, DeKalb County, Jackson County, Forsyth County.

rotatingFeatures.label: HOMEOWNER / SEASONAL HOME TIP
rotatingFeatures.title: Test Every Smoke Alarm Before Heating Season
paragraphs: Use an early-fall morning to press the test button on every smoke alarm in the house. Replace a unit or battery if the alarm does not sound, and follow the manufacturer's instructions for the model in your home.
items: Test alarms on every level and near sleeping areas.
Vacuum dust gently from alarm openings without painting or covering the unit.
Check the manufacture date and replacement guidance printed on the alarm.
rotatingFeatures.closing: It is a quick check that is easier to handle now than after the first cold night.
rotatingFeatures.source: UGA Cooperative Extension, Home Maintenance Checklist

rotatingFeatures.label: LOCAL COMMUNITY EVENT
rotatingFeatures.title: Gwinnett Hispanic Latino Heritage Month Celebration
paragraphs: Gwinnett County's Hispanic Latino Heritage Month celebration is planned at the Gwinnett Justice and Administration Center with local performers, food vendors, artists, and community activities.
Check the official county page before attending for the latest program and visitor details.
rotatingFeatures.closing: Gwinnett Justice and Administration Center, 75 Langley Drive, Lawrenceville.

cartoon.closing: A quick safety test can still be the loudest item on the weekend list.
